remarks: Don't miss this bright, updated top-floor end unit offering abundant natural light, a private one-car garage with storage, and a balcony retreat - a rare blend of comfort, style, and convenience! The open-concept layout features a spacious living and dining area that flows into a well-appointed kitchen, perfect for both everyday living and easy entertaining.  The bedroom includes a walk-in closet and sliding glass doors that open to your own private balcony - an ideal spot to enjoy morning coffee or unwind at sunset. A renovated full bathroom adds a modern, stylish touch, while a brand-new stackable washer/dryer provides everyday convenience.  Recent exterior upgrades include new siding and a freshly paved driveway, enhancing both curb appeal and long-term value. Rare at this price point, the home includes a private one-car garage with an additional dedicated storage room - a valuable feature for any homeowner.  Conveniently located, just minutes from Metro North, I-95, Route 7, the SONO Collection, Maritime Center, Calf Pasture Beach, and South Norwalk's restaurant scene, this location offers exceptional convenience. This turnkey, low-maintenance home is an ideal choice for first-time buyers or savvy investors!  Highest and best by Tuesday, July 8th at 5pm. Please submit all disclosures and documents with offers.
